<p class="bms-glossary-term-name">Stop Pot</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-definition">In backgammon, Stop Pot refers to a progressive side event in which players may enter at a level and cash out or continue after winning. The term gives players a shared way to talk about this part of the game.</p>
